messages.author: 13d01984f5682713
messages.subject: how to set initial values in Rstan
parts: Hi, the following attachments are my Rstan code and stan file. Since a big number of iteration and several chains can cost lots of time, I run the code eight times with one chain and 5000 iterations each time. However, what happened was that all eight chains are totally same. I don't know what caused this? Is that because I did not set initial values for parameters every time? If yes, how can I set initial values? Thank you very much.

parts:
On Thursday, March 23, 2017 at 12:57:35 PM UTC-4, Ru Wang wrote:
I see. And do you know why I get the same right chains for my last run? Run 8 times and each time with one chain.
You can, but you have to set the seed to the same value and the chain_id to the appropriate value.
